title: Cute & functional
text:
Cute & functional. I love these mugs! They are the perfect size & use them for just about everything...from coffee, to ramen to ice cream.

I highly recommend these, the quality is great & they come in pretty colors.

product_metadata.title: Sicaluya Porcelain Large Oatmeal Mug with Lid, 23 oz (680mL) Wide Coffee Mug, Breakfast Cup and Soup Bowl, Microwave and Dishwasher Safe, Ceramic Mug for Milk, Tea, Fruit, Ice Cream (Yellow)
features: 【LARGE CAPACITY 】 Wide-mouth with lid, 23 Ounce(680mL) capacity soup bowl with lid can meet all of your need for serving different kinds of food.

【THICKENED AND SAFE】 These porcelain large mugs are made of durable porcelain, a type of premium LEAD-FREE. This is a thickened ceramic cup, stronger, chip-resistant and more sturdy than stoneware. Safe for microwave, dishwasher, freezer, oven and disinfection cabinet.

【MULTIPLE USE】 This mug has a very smooth and clean finish, simple design - great for daily use in all settings. It is perfect for mulled drinks, cereal, oatmeal, protein shakes, soup, hot chocolate, noodles, coffee and tea.
【STRONGER HANDLE】 The user-friendly handle is comfortable to grip. Perfect size, Stronger handle, unique appearance make these mugs ideal for family use.
【ELEGANT COLOR】 Simple and elegant color matching makes your life more colorful.
